transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
Hello, doctor. Lately I just can’t think straight or make decisions at work the way I used to. It's gotten to the point where I'm really struggling to keep up with my daily tasks at the warehouse.
Have you experienced these feelings of difficulty concentrating and low mood before in your life, perhaps several years ago, or is this the first time you have felt this way?

No, it's not the first time. I've had these alternating stretches of feeling really low and then revved up off and on for at least the past couple of years. They've really come to a head this past year with the pressure at work, and this current slump has been dragging on since last fall.
During those 'revved up' periods you mentioned, did you feel unusually energetic, need much less sleep than normal, or find yourself taking uncharacteristic risks?

Yes, during those times I felt like I was running on an extra battery, staying up until two in the morning working on my motorcycle without feeling tired at all. I'd take on way too many projects at once and do things I normally wouldn't, like driving way too fast on the highway at night or spending a bunch on my credit card for tools without talking to my wife.
During those 'revved up' periods, how many days in a row did these symptoms typically last, and did they ever become severe enough to interfere with your job or require medical attention?

Those "on" weeks usually last for about a week or two at a time, and back then I felt so on top of the world that I never thought I needed any help. But the constant back-and-forth between those highs and these low slumps eventually made my leadership at work really unpredictable and hurt my family life, which is what finally pushed me to see a doctor after a colleague spoke up.

During your current 'slump' that started last fall, have you felt completely unable to experience pleasure in almost all activities, or have you noticed a significant change in your appetite or physical movements?

Yes, since last fall I've felt completely numb toward my favorite hobbies like working on my bike or fishing, and I just end up sitting on the couch doing nothing. I also have to remind myself to eat, often going all day on just coffee, and my wife keeps asking if I'm okay because I've been moving so slowly, shuffling around and sometimes just standing frozen.
During this current period where you feel numb and lack appetite, have these feelings been so severe that you have had thoughts that life is not worth living or that you would be better off dead?

To be honest, yes, I have had those thoughts. Sometimes I think it wouldn't be so bad if I just didn't wake up in the morning, and on the really rough days I've even pictured driving my truck into a wall. I haven't made any actual plans to do it, but the thoughts are there.

During these current periods where you feel numb and have thoughts about ending your life, have you ever heard voices that others cannot hear or held beliefs that felt undeniably true to you but were actually not based in reality?
No, I have never heard any voices that others couldn't hear, and I've never held beliefs that weren't based in reality. Even during my lowest points, I have never experienced anything like that.

During your 'revved up' periods in the past, did you ever experience any hallucinations or hold beliefs that were clearly not based in reality, such as feeling like you had special powers or were being targeted?

No, I never experienced any hallucinations or thought I had supernatural powers or that anyone was targeting me. I did get very overconfident and talked big about how I could run the whole region better than the corporate bosses, but I always knew deep down I was just a guy with a middle-school education who learned on the job.
